title: Listing-aware cross-sectional funding, momentum, and carry ranks on liquid Binance USD-M perpetuals

mechanism.summary: At each UTC close, rank only point-in-time eligible perpetuals. Form a 0.5x-gross equal-weight long basket from the top five and a 0.5x-gross short basket from the bottom five; execute one day later. Six frozen score definitions are evaluated without threshold rescue.
mechanism.portfolio: Dollar-neutral top-five/bottom-five, gross <=1.0x NAV, explicit fully collateralized Binance venue pool.

data_used.source: Official unauthenticated Binance public data archive (data.binance.vision)
datasets: USD-M perpetual 1h klines with quote volume

parameters.funding_lookback_completeness: fund3 requires 3/3 observed funding days; fundchg requires 10/10

signal_timing: At close t-1 the drifted book is rebalanced/fee-solved into target[t-1] (a zero target explicitly closes the book); that exact quantity vector earns outcome day t (price return plus signed funding). The same held vector drives censoring, concentration and the collateral audit. The boundary rebalance fee is charged in period t.

cost_model.funding: Each signed event is mapped by ts//86400000 to its UTC outcome day and summed exactly. Long total return subtracts signed funding; negative funding paid by shorts remains negative in portfolio PnL.
cost_model.turnover: Drift-aware and self-financing from the explicit quantity/notional + cash/NAV ledger: fees are charged on |target notional - current drifted notional| at each close boundary, including explicit closes; emitted returns telescope exactly to final NAV.
cost_model.censor_rule: First held incomplete outcome only: all held censored assets are recorded, row t and the entire tail are marked unavailable (NaN), and the path breaks. No zero-imputation, no trade-out at an unavailable close, no finite zero tail.

benchmark.name: Per-variant equal-weight benchmark over the identical per-asset causal signal mask
benchmark.constituents: exactly signal_opportunity[t-1]; no ex-post filtering on outcome completeness
benchmark.path_stop: benchmark path stops (NaN row and tail) if any held constituent outcome at t is incomplete
benchmark.return_definition: mean total long-perp return (price return minus signed funding) of those constituents

metrics.rank_ic_outcome: tie-corrected average-rank Spearman of score[t-1] vs outcome t total long-perp return (price minus signed funding); observed-pair mask = per-asset signal opportunity at t-1 AND complete outcome t; constant cross-section -> NaN

first_falsification_gate.definition: At least 20 point-in-time eligible assets; purged-fold rank IC >0.02; positive long-short spread at 2x costs; no asset above 25% of PnL; delisted histories retained; explicit collateral buffer has no breach.

gate_result.truth_table: pass iff all required gates true; falsified if any required gate observably false (false dominates unknown); inconclusive only if no false and >=1 unknown
gate_result.direction_falsified_solely_because: every variant has an observed false development-subperiod IC gate (valid observation at or below 0.02)

confirmation_gate_status_after_stop.note: The first held incomplete outcome on 2022-02-26 stops every variant path; row 574 and the tail are NaN/unavailable, so these gates are UNKNOWN, not pass.

leakage_checks: Universe selection uses the frozen official archive prefix snapshot and deterministic archive-age/lexicographic rule, never today-listed winners.
Only unavailable funding asset-months fail closed; future missing months do not retrospectively remove earlier complete history.
Funding events use ts//86400000: exact 00:00 UTC events belong to that outcome day and never leak into prior-close features.
Signals formed at close t are applied only to next-day outcomes; minimum cross-section breadth is checked before target construction.
Rank IC outcome is next-day price return minus same-day exact signed funding, matching the perpetual mechanism before fees.
All six registered variants are enumerable; no threshold, leverage, benchmark, stop, or extra variant was introduced after gate inspection.
holdout_accessed=true because the retrospective 2025-01-01..2026-07-31 confirmation window was deliberately evaluated; no blind or prospective holdout claim is made.
risks: 137 monthly funding archive URLs returned HTTP 404 across 15 symbols; unknown funding is NaN and never imputed.
The first held incomplete outcome (2022-02-26) truncates every variant path, so validation and confirmation gates are unknown rather than measured.
Official archive first/last months are a listing/delisting proxy, not an announcement-time instrument master.
Collateral audit uses simultaneous daily long lows and short highs on available rows only; it is conservative but not a tick-level replay.
No comparable point-in-time OKX archive was obtained; adding current OKX instruments would survivor-filter.
The 59-asset sample is frozen, deterministic and nonrepresentative (no BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT); every verdict is scoped to it.
All windows are retrospective; they cannot establish durable alpha.
next_experiment: No threshold rescue and no new variants. A future prospective campaign would need an append-only announcement-time instrument master (to avoid censor truncation) plus forward price/funding capture after 2026-08-30, then re-test the same six frozen mechanisms.
question: Do listing-aware cross-sectional funding, momentum, and carry ranks produce stable information and a net long-short spread across liquid perpetuals?
holdout_note: The retrospective 2025-01-01..2026-07-31 confirmation window was deliberately evaluated; it is not a blind or prospective holdout. Scope: frozen 59-asset subsample; no current winners included.
epistemic_note: All windows are retrospective; development was performed in 2026 with knowledge of later evidence. Results may falsify mechanics but cannot confirm durable alpha.

universe.source: Binance official public data bucket (data.binance.vision), USD-M monthly 1h klines listing per symbol, S3 ListObjectsV2 XML preserved
universe.survivor_filter: none; assets remain in panel after last kline (delisting evidence = official archive ends)
universe.point_in_time_rule: Eligible at signal time t iff the complete 20-observation price/volume window ending at t is observed (no NaN, listed throughout) with mean quote volume >= $5M (complete-20 SSOT, provenance/universe_frame_note.json), AND day-t signed funding is observed, AND the variant score is finite (which requires its full registered lookback). Portfolio and benchmark constituents are drawn only from this per-asset causal signal mask.
universe.okx: Not added: the bounded frozen acquisition did not obtain an official point-in-time listing/delisting archive comparable to Binance. Adding current OKX instruments would impose survivor filtering.
universe.selection_rule: Within the deterministic 135-symbol official-archive coverage probe, include every USDT symbol first archived by 2022-12 plus the first 20 later symbols in lexicographic order. This uses archive age/order, not current winners. Unavailable funding asset-months alone fail closed; earlier complete histories remain eligible, so future data completeness cannot survivor-filter the past.
universe.seasoning_rule: complete 20 observations (canonical; identical in code, provenance and this dossier)
universe.delisting_retention_invariant: Delisted and failed histories are retained in the panel rows and never filtered by present-day listing status; failure evidence (archive end months) is documented in delisted_archive_end_months. This is a data invariant of the frozen universe; it is not a truth-table gate.

method.features: 21d return momentum, 3d mean of exact summed signed funding events, 3d-versus-prior-7d funding change, 21d realized volatility, past-20d dollar-volume liquidity; cross-sectional z-scores for composite.
method.execution: signal at close t-1 -> position t (1-day delay); dollar-neutral equal-weight top5/bot5
method.costs: 1x: 4bp taker per unit turnover; 2x: 8bp. Every funding event is summed with its original sign: positive paid by longs/received by shorts; negative paid by shorts.
method.folds: Six consecutive chronological purged subperiods over the development window (each subperiod test start advanced 30 days past its partition start; nothing is fitted, so subperiods are non-training partitions). Window rank IC uses only dates with >=20 eligible assets. The confirmation window is evaluated separately as a full-window IC.
method.accounting: Single Binance venue, explicit fully collateralized venue pool, derivative gross <=1.0x NAV, no borrowing, net target 0, maintenance 10% plus declared 20% isolation buffer audited against simultaneous daily extrema; no buffer breaches or liquidations.
method.rank_ic_outcome: Score at close t-1 versus close[t-1] to close[t] long-perpetual price return minus every exact signed funding event timestamped on UTC day t (including 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00), before fees.

gates_registered.note: Missing or censored evidence makes a gate UNKNOWN, never false. Truth table: pass iff all gates observed true; falsified if any gate observably false; inconclusive only if no false and >=1 unknown. Delisting retention is a universe/data invariant (see universe section), not a truth-table gate.

gate_outcome.source: regenerated from the corrected result object (results.json / explore1_results.json)
gate_outcome.concentration_gate: 0.25 max single-asset PnL share (unknown after censor stop for all variants)
gate_outcome.collateral_gate: zero buffer breaches (unknown after censor stop for all variants)

verdict_basis: Frozen truth table applied once to the production engine: direction status is falsified solely because every variant has an observed false development-subperiod IC gate. The 2022-02-26 first held incomplete outcome stops every variant path; row 574 and the tail are NaN/unavailable, so confirmation IC, 2x spread, concentration and collateral gates are UNKNOWN, not pass. Scope: frozen 59-asset subsample; retrospective evidence only; no durable-alpha or deployment claim.

benchmarks.definition: causal equal-weight long-only of prior-close eligible assets; detailed window values in trials.json
benchmarks.note: benchmark excess is reported separately and is not the positive-spread gate

data_provenance.checksums: Computed SHA-256, byte size, URL and retrieval UTC recorded for every successful raw archive in provenance/*.json; HTTP 404s preserved as records.
data_provenance.retrieval_policy: Official data.binance.vision keyless GETs; URL, retrieval UTC, bytes, SHA-256 and HTTP errors recorded in provenance/*.json; no further retries after frozen capture.
data_provenance.terms: Binance public unauthenticated data for internal research; raw archives are not republished.
